one_liner: A simple app that maps a video (file or HLS stream) onto a 3D mesh, supporting looping, aspect ratio, and fit options.
primary_use_case: Display and play video textures on 3D objects, enabling curved or 360° video playback within Hyperfy worlds.
preview_recommendation: The PNG preview shows the video mesh on a screen; it is suitable for quick visual checks of the app's appearance.
manifest_quality_notes: All required assets (model and script) are present.
Preview image is available and correctly linked.
UI configuration for props is defined.
No server‑side logic or networking used.
Potential missing video source if user does not provide file or URL.
